Status.note: The EIA-860M table for September 2026 (https://www.eia.gov/electricity/data/eia860m/xls/september_generator2026.xlsx) lists plant 60559, generators MEC1, MEC2 and MEC3, as operating, 17.1 MW each, operating August 2017, with no planned retirement. The Michigan air quality staff report from October 2019 also describes the engines as running. I found no retirement, mothballing or sale notice.

Equipment Manufacturer/Model.note: The Michigan air quality staff report from October 2019 (https://www.egle.state.mi.us/aps/downloads/ROP/pub_ntce/P0668/P0668%20Staff%20Report%2010-01-19.pdf) says the Marquette Energy Center has three Wärtsilä 18V50DF reciprocating engines that finished installation in 2017. A Wärtsilä press release from November 2015 (https://www.wartsila.com/media/news/20-11-2015-wartsila-supplies-50-mw-of-reliable-power-capacity-to-michigan-usa) announced the supply of the 50 MW plant to Marquette. The permit staff report gives the full model name.
